Lazarus, John 11. Jesus loved Mary, Martha, and their brother, yet stayed away until Lazarus died, then said, I am the resurrection, and the life, and called him out of the grave. Tears, waiting, a stone rolled, a wrapped man walking, all point to a greater rising. If hope feels late, do not read God's silence as His absence. He works on purpose, in His time, for our faith and His glory.
